source: specs/063-clean-rebuild-contract/spec.md (product-flow steps and feature ownership) and the "Owned interaction steps" section of each spec 064 to 072

entries.spec: 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-01, LIB-FR-02; D18, D-W12
entries.action: Read the Locations step, then add Astro-T7/Captures with the native folder picker and a display name, and add Cold-1/Captures as a second Captures folder.
entries.expect: Captures is marked required and the optional roles are named. Each row shows its path, role, volume kind, access state and Online.
entries.negative: Adding a folder starts no indexing and creates, renames, moves or deletes no file. No processing application, Project, run folder, workspace root or account is requested.

entries.spec: 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-01, LIB-AC-01
entries.action: Add the Astro-T7/Calibration location and leave Results unset.
entries.expect: Onboarding continues and Results reads not set.
entries.negative: The unset Results role is not shown as an error, a warning or a failed setup.

entries.spec: 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-03, LIB-FR-04, LIB-FR-05, LIB-FR-06, LIB-FR-07, LIB-FR-09, LIB-FR-12, LIB-AC-02, LIB-AC-03, LIB-AC-04, LIB-AC-05, LIB-AC-06; D01, D11, D15, D-W37
entries.action: Start indexing, inspect the resulting sessions and their association evidence, confirm Targets and the RedCat rig in the catalog, and rescan with an unreadable session folder and then with it restored. Verify the manifest and take Cold-1 offline.
entries.expect: Seven metadata-homogeneous light sessions appear, each frame Unreviewed, with the evidence behind each association. Needs review appears where evidence is missing or conflicts, and confirmations change only the catalog. The unreadable folder reads unknown scope until it is restored.
entries.negative: No session mixes channels and no OBJECT label alone assigns a Target. Source bytes stay byte-identical to the manifest, and unreadable or offline frames never read Missing.

entries.spec: 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-03, LIB-FR-07, LIB-FR-10, LIB-FR-15, LIB-AC-07, LIB-AC-09, LIB-AC-16; D-W97, D-W98, D-W100
entries.action: Browse Home and Sessions while indexing runs, recover the denied location with Retry, and take Cold-1 offline. Later review retiring the lost archive location, meet a refusal after it returns, retire it from a fresh review, and register its folder again.
entries.expect: Home shows its current sections and provisional totals name their locations. The denied row offers Choose folder again and Retry, and an offline location keeps last-observed metadata. Retirement review names the location and the sessions, Projects and Results in Output/ that reference it; retired copies remain named unresolved, and registering the folder again creates a new location.
entries.negative: Offline, denied or retired files never read Missing or empty. Retirement changes no file, and no retired decision, association or correction transfers to the re-registered copies.

entries.spec: 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-08, LIB-FR-10, LIB-AC-05, LIB-AC-09; D18, D-W39
entries.action: From Home, search Targets for NGC 7000 and open its Target page.
entries.expect: Captured, library-wide usable and Unreviewed integration show by channel, with usable at 0h 00m and Unreviewed equal to captured. Availability is a separate state, and the 12 Sep OIII contribution counts in captured with its last-observed values and reads Offline.
entries.negative: The offline contribution is not offered as an available processing input, and search needs no network connection.

entries.spec: 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-01, PRJ-FR-02, PRJ-FR-03, PRJ-FR-04, PRJ-FR-05, PRJ-FR-08, PRJ-FR-09, PRJ-FR-31, PRJ-FR-12; D-W90, D-W94, D-W95, D-W96, D-W105
entries.action: Create Project NGC 7000 HOO from the Target with rig RedCat and the HOO goal template, review its suggestions and goals, edit a goal and add rig Esprit. Later lower the Ha goal until it reads met and set it back.
entries.expect: The Project starts with NGC 7000 and Ha 10h and OIII 10h goals. Suggestions are Ready sessions whose confirmed Target and rig match the Project, and are not added automatically. Each goal shows in project and captured; in project counts the Project's sessions, while captured includes matching suggestions. A met goal leaves the Project open.
entries.negative: Creating or editing the Project changes no file and no quality state. No session joins without the user's action, and captured never reads lower than in project.

entries.spec: 072-observing-plans PLAN-FR-01, PLAN-FR-09, PLAN-FR-10, PLAN-AC-01, PLAN-AC-10, PLAN-TGT-AC-14; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-06, PRJ-FR-07; D-W16, D-W88, D-W89, D-W95, D-W96
entries.action: Inspect the Project sessions' capture sites, switch the planning site on the Project page and in Targets, and open the Planner from the Project.
entries.expect: Each session keeps its capture site, and windows recalculate and name the chosen planning site and time zone. Open in Planner limits Targets to the Project's subjects with the rig selector on this Project's rigs.
entries.negative: Changing the planning site changes no Project session, group, capture site or membership, and notifications stay disabled unless the user opts in.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-01, VSEL-FR-03, VSEL-AC-16; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-08, PRJ-FR-09; D-W94, D-W96, D-W105
entries.action: From a Target page, preview adding the Target to an existing Project, then use the Project's Sessions step to add a Ready session whose calibration is settled.
entries.expect: The Target page offers Add to Project and New Project, not a run action. The Project receives only sessions the user adds, and a session can be added only when Ready and calibration is settled.
entries.negative: No standalone run or Target-only processing action exists. Adding a Target or session creates no file and changes no library quality state.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-01, VSEL-FR-02, VSEL-FR-06, VSEL-FR-08, VSEL-FR-12; D-W94, D-W96, D-W100
entries.action: Review a Project's selected sessions and included frames, browse the list with filters and Sky coverage, and read its current desired inputs and pending-change count.
entries.expect: The Project's Sessions step shows its groups, held sessions, suggestions, exclusions and pending changes. Browsing filters and Sky coverage leaves selected session identities unchanged.
entries.negative: No run header, fixed run identity, run Trash or separate Select/Review/Calibrate/Prepare rail is shown. Browsing does not change Project inputs.

entries.flowStep: Project Sessions step: groups, suggestions, Add sessions… and exclusions
entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-02, VSEL-FR-03, VSEL-FR-10, VSEL-FR-12, VSEL-AC-01, VSEL-AC-04, VSEL-AC-16; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-07, PRJ-FR-08, PRJ-FR-09, PRJ-FR-31; D-W94, D-W95, D-W96, D-W100, D-W105
entries.action: Open the Project's Sessions step, read its groups and suggestions, choose Add sessions… and add the suggested sessions, exclude six frames of one session, and later add a session from the Not in any Project filter.
entries.expect: The Sessions step lists the Project's groups with their sessions and frame counts, its suggestions with the Target and rig each matches, and its pending changes. Add sessions… lists Ready sessions with settled calibration first; a suggestion that needs calibration reads "Choose its flats first" and can't be added. Added sessions join groups by rig and framing, and the exclusion changes only this Project's counts.
entries.negative: No suggestion is added automatically, an OBJECT label alone never makes a session a suggestion, and once the View exists nothing in it changes before Apply. Excluding frames changes no file, no library quality and no other Project.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-03, VSEL-FR-04, VSEL-AC-01; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-09, PRJ-FR-31; D-W33, D-W37, D-W95, D-W96, D-W105
entries.action: Read the Project's session suggestions, including a session whose OBJECT label differs from its confirmed Target.
entries.expect: Matching Ready sessions with settled calibration are offered as suggestions with the reason Target and rig match. Sessions with no confirmed Target or unsettled calibration cannot be added; geometry evidence orders suggestions and supports framing groups.
entries.negative: No session from an unrelated rig or Target is an automatic suggestion. Listing or selecting a suggestion adds no session and changes no Target.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-04, VSEL-AC-02; D01, D-W33
entries.action: Open the geometry evidence of a session with a footprint, a pointing-only session and a Position unknown session, then clear and check the unknown one.
entries.expect: FOV from confirmed equipment lists its inputs, the pointing-only session shows a distance and no footprint, and Position unknown shows no distance. The unknown session can be checked like any other.
entries.negative: Unknown geometry never shows a distance of 0 or a footprint derived from a Target or OBJECT label, and it removes no suggestion.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-05, VSEL-FR-06, VSEL-AC-03, VSEL-AC-18; 067-frame-review PIX-AC-06; D-W37
entries.action: Apply the channel, Missing OBJECT and quality-state filters, open the expanded controls, sort by sky distance, and search.
entries.expect: Filter chips, match counts and the count of selected sessions hidden by filters show. Measurement columns read Not measured.
entries.negative: Filters change no selected session and no session definition, offer no equipment control, show no other-rig session, and start no measurement.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-06, VSEL-FR-08, VSEL-FR-10, VSEL-FR-12, VSEL-FR-15; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-04, PRJ-FR-08; D-W78, D-W94, D-W96, D-W100
entries.action: Show the Project's selected sessions, clear and restore the selection with Select matching, browse with sorting, paging and Sky coverage, then add or exclude a session.
entries.expect: Available Usable frames are included, library-Unusable frames start visibly excluded, and the selection survives filters and paging. Adding or excluding after the View exists appears as a pending change; Project totals count its own sessions and matching suggestions under their respective labels.
entries.negative: Selection applies no quality action, does not create a membership revision, and changes no View before Apply. Offline or other-rig sessions are not silently added.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-09, VSEL-FR-12, VSEL-FR-14, VSEL-AC-09, VSEL-AC-31; D-W100
entries.action: Review an offline session held by the Project, read its state and pending changes, and open the Apply sheet.
entries.expect: The session remains listed with last-observed metadata and unresolved originals named. Apply offers reconnect, locate or explicit removal and is disabled while a required original is offline.
entries.negative: An offline session is never dropped silently, counted as verified or treated as an absent original. The View and View (previous)/ remain unchanged.

entries.spec: 067-frame-review PIX-FR-01, PIX-FR-06, PIX-FR-10, PIX-AC-01, PIX-AC-10; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-20; D19, D-W78, D-W79
entries.action: Open a session's Review step, inspect frames while measuring, cancel and reopen. Replace a reviewed frame's bytes in place, rescan, then restore the reviewed bytes.
entries.expect: Pending frames and progress show, and after Cancel unfinished frames read Not measured. Cached values reappear on reopening and remaining measurements resume. A changed frame is outside valid quality totals until its reviewed bytes return or it is reviewed again.
entries.negative: Cancel changes no selection or Project membership. Cached values for other bytes never read valid, imported values never read verified, and measurement records no quality decision.

entries.spec: 067-frame-review PIX-FR-02, PIX-FR-03, PIX-FR-04, PIX-FR-10, PIX-FR-11, PIX-FR-12, PIX-FR-13, PIX-FR-15, PIX-FR-16, PIX-AC-02, PIX-AC-07, PIX-AC-14, PIX-AC-15, PIX-AC-17; D-W13, D-W14, D-W15, D-W40, D-W78, D-W79
entries.action: Select frames from a row and plot point, zoom, pan, compare and step frames, apply and remove a stretch, switch views and table heights, change the frame-name display template, and select by threshold.
entries.expect: The selected frame is highlighted in every view, plot and preview, and the disclosure shows metadata, source and units. Measured values are identical with stretch on and off, and threshold selection picks exactly the measured frames past the value.
entries.negative: Stretching, thumbnails and the display-name template change no measured value, source byte or file name. Threshold selection changes no quality state or Project input.

entries.spec: 067-frame-review PIX-FR-05, PIX-FR-06, PIX-AC-03
entries.action: Enable Stars and inspect a fitted star and a saturated star.
entries.expect: Fit details and cutouts show, with distinct HFR and FWHM labels and units. The saturated star reads failed fit with a saturation warning.
entries.negative: No FWHM or other fitted-width number is shown for a failed fit.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-10, VSEL-FR-12, VSEL-FR-14, VSEL-AC-30; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-04; D-W94, D-W100
entries.action: Exclude six 30 Sep frames from the Project, restore and re-exclude one, read the totals and Apply changes.
entries.expect: The 30 Sep session shows the updated included-frame count, and the Project's in-project totals reflect its exclusions. The Apply sheet lists the exact frames added or removed from the View.
entries.negative: Files stay on disk until separately approved custody operations. Library quality, Target totals and another Project's inputs remain unchanged.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-12, VSEL-FR-15; 067-frame-review PIX-FR-13, PIX-FR-14, PIX-AC-12, PIX-AC-16; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-17, LIB-FR-20; D-W78, D-W79, D-W100
entries.action: Check that the Project's Ready sessions hold no Unreviewed frame, reject and re-pick a frame with hotkeys, and inspect the Project's pending changes after a library mark reaches it.
entries.expect: The Project's Ready sessions hold no Unreviewed frame, and Needs review lists none of them. Library marks are global; a rejection reaching an open Project is a pending change labelled with its source.
entries.negative: Single-frame hotkey marks do not ask for confirmation or create a Project membership revision. There is no Project-only reject, and a library mark does not mutate the View before Apply.

entries.spec: 067-frame-review PIX-FR-06, PIX-FR-07, PIX-FR-08, PIX-AC-04, PIX-AC-05, PIX-AC-11; D03, D19
entries.action: Import a SubframeSelector CSV after one measured frame changes in place, confirm the mapping, and inspect the unresolved rows.
entries.expect: Matched, unmatched and ambiguous rows are listed, and the changed frame's row is listed for review against its recorded digest. Imported values show with provenance next to native values and read content unverified.
entries.negative: No native value is replaced, no imported value attaches to the changed frame or reads verified, and no exclusion or quality change is imported. A column without units is never labeled FWHM or HFR.

entries.spec: 068-calibration-inputs CAL-FR-01, CAL-FR-03, CAL-FR-09, CAL-FR-19, CAL-FR-20, CAL-FR-21, CAL-FR-22; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-23, LIB-FR-24; D-W101, D-W102, D-W103, D-W104, D-W105
entries.action: Import light sessions with compatible flats, darks and bias, read each import-review match state, then open the session's calibration details.
entries.expect: A fully compatible match is pinned automatically on the session. Review shows each kind as pinned automatically, suggested for confirmation, or not found; a settled session has a pin or explicit No choice for every kind.
entries.negative: Unknown or incompatible evidence and matches outside their windows are never pinned automatically. Dark flats are never matched or assigned, and calibration does not wait for a Project step.

entries.spec: 068-calibration-inputs CAL-FR-05, CAL-FR-19, CAL-FR-20, CAL-FR-21; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-23, LIB-FR-25; D-W101, D-W102, D-W103, D-W105, D-W106
entries.action: Review a suggested flat for a light session, confirm or reassign it, and inspect that session's pinned assignment after calibration arrives later.
entries.expect: The session shows the chosen flat and its evidence. Calibration imported later fills only sessions still waiting, never replaces a pin, and a user's reassignment is retained.
entries.negative: A suggestion remains unpinned until confirmed. Reassignment does not rewrite calibration evidence or silently change another session or a Closed or Archived Project.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-01, PREP-FR-02, PREP-AC-23, PREP-AC-24; D-W83, D-W98
entries.action: Choose the Siril profile for the Project's View and locate its executable; then select a generic Open in… application instead.
entries.expect: The View application dropdown lists detected or added applications. Profile capability evidence and unsupported configuration are named; Open in… asks for an executable and arguments and is not described as a verified profile.
entries.negative: No capability is claimed as verified without evidence, no profile claims that renaming files overrides headers, and choosing an application launches nothing.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-03, PREP-FR-08, PREP-FR-09, PREP-FR-20, PREP-FR-21, PREP-AC-06, PREP-AC-39; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-12, LIB-FR-20; D-W93, D-W98, D-W100, D-W122, D-W123; HARNESS-V5-FEEDBACK-R1.md Round 9 C15
entries.action: Open the Apply sheet and read its Corrected values section, which lists corrections recorded at intake, then Apply the reviewed View.
entries.expect: The Apply sheet gives the corrected-value count and lists each session, field, header value, corrected value and route. J23/S11 reads the patched FITS copy through PlateVault's metadata reader; this verifies the copy, not whether the selected tool consumes the value. For an application with no evidence about which header keys it reads, Apply reports 'N corrected values written to patched copies' and makes no claim about application reading (D-W123; owner's answer, 2026-10-19, astro-plan-rzbzu.1).
entries.negative: Apply offers no per-value choice and creates or changes no catalog correction. Originals are never edited; only patched copies' headers change. No original or symlink target is patched (D-W123; owner's answer, 2026-10-19, astro-plan-rzbzu.1). Under PREP-FR-03, a correction is not reported as delivered while the tool still reads the source value.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-04, PREP-AC-08, PREP-AC-25; D-W81, D-W98
entries.action: Read the Project's input modes and choose Symlinks.
entries.expect: Symlinks and Copies state their semantics and storage, Symlinks is the default, and Copies says when the volume supports clones.
entries.negative: No other input mode is offered, and the mode does not change without the user's explicit choice and Apply.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-06, PREP-FR-08, PREP-AC-01, PREP-AC-02, PREP-AC-09; D-W98, D-W100
entries.action: Choose a processing location whose Project folder already exists, lose the selected parent, then explicitly choose Work/Processing. Later read the next Project's suggested location.
entries.expect: An existing Project folder and an unavailable parent each prompt another choice. The selected parent contains the Project folder with View/, Processing/ and Output/, and the next location suggestion uses the last chosen parent.
entries.negative: Existing folders and their contents are not reused or cleared, and no other drive or parent is substituted silently.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-06, PREP-FR-07, PREP-AC-01; 070-results-reuse RES-FR-01, RES-FR-06; D-W93, D-W98
entries.action: Review the Project folder layout and the selected tool's working directory.
entries.expect: The Project folder contains View/, Processing/<Tool>/ and Output/. The tool's working and output files go under Processing/<Tool>/, and results are kept in Output/.
entries.negative: No separate Run Results folder or Results-parent override is offered. Tools never write into Output/.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-08, PREP-FR-09, VSEL-FR-14, VSEL-AC-30, VSEL-AC-31; D-W100
entries.action: Open Apply and review the exact desired Project inputs, calibration assignments, exclusions, layout, mode, paths and required space before confirming.
entries.expect: The sheet shows changes and their sources, the new View as a folder tree, unresolved and offline originals, space, operation count and tool-specific layout notes. Where Symlinks cannot be used, Copies is offered explicitly.
entries.negative: Nothing is written before Apply. Unknown or omitted inputs never count as placed, and a link plan never becomes a copy silently.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-06, PREP-FR-09, PREP-AC-05, PREP-AC-14; 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-14; D-W100
entries.action: Apply the Project's desired inputs, retry after restoring an offline or drifted source, and apply another change to rebuild the View.
entries.expect: Apply reports Running and progress, names blocked entries, and reports success only after every new View entry matches the Project inputs and source snapshot. A retry places an entry only after fresh source verification.
entries.negative: An acknowledgement is not success. Apply never reuses or clears the current View or creates a revision-numbered folder, and failure leaves the current View unchanged.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-10, PREP-AC-10, PREP-AC-15; D-W81, D-W100
entries.action: Open the Project View with a missing executable, after a linked input changes, then restore the input and launch the application.
entries.expect: Choose application and Reveal View are offered. Open re-verifies every entry before launch; a changed entry refuses launch and is named against its Apply snapshot.
entries.negative: The Project remains open and its View unchanged. The external application never launches on changed bytes, and quitting it does not mark the Project complete or closed.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-12, VSEL-FR-14, VSEL-FR-21, VSEL-AC-30, VSEL-AC-31, VSEL-AC-29; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-09, LIB-FR-11; D19, D-W94, D-W100
entries.action: Index two new matching sessions, make an existing session unreadable and reconfirm another session's Target. Review the resulting pending changes, then apply after every required original is online.
entries.expect: Matching sessions appear as suggestions and are not added automatically. Changes to held sessions and external changes appear with their source; Apply lists exact additions and unresolved inputs, and a successful Apply rebuilds from originals.
entries.negative: No Refresh or Reopen action exists. Membership changes only by user action, no unresolved session is silently removed, and the current View is unchanged before Apply succeeds.

entries.spec: 070-results-reuse RES-FR-01, RES-AC-01, RES-AC-28; 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-07; D-W93, D-W98
entries.action: Open the Project's Output step, then rerun the tool so it overwrites a file under Processing/.
entries.expect: Output lists each file in Output/ with kind, channel, state and availability where known; a growing file reads Still being written. Tool files stay in Processing/.
entries.negative: No file is auto-accepted, attributed to a run or revision, or discovered from inside View/ or Processing/. A tool rerun does not change Output/.

entries.spec: 070-results-reuse RES-FR-02, RES-FR-06, RES-AC-02; 071-storage-custody STO-FR-07; D-W93, D-W98
entries.action: Choose Copy to Output… on the Project's Output step and select a TIFF from Processing/ as a Final image.
entries.expect: The verified copy appears in Output/ as a Result. The file in Processing/ remains unchanged, and the row exposes Kind and Channel fields.
entries.negative: No Attach Result action, User-linked association or lineage is recorded, and an existing Output file is never overwritten.

entries.spec: 070-results-reuse RES-FR-01, RES-FR-02, RES-AC-01; D-W93, D-W98
entries.action: Set Kind and Channel on a Result row in Output/, then inspect the Result after it is saved there.
entries.expect: The row shows the selected Kind and Channel and remains a Result because every file in Output/ is a Result.
entries.negative: There is no Accept, Ignore, Keep protection, acceptance digest, input lineage or Result-to-Project input action.

entries.spec: 068-calibration-inputs CAL-FR-06, CAL-FR-07, CAL-FR-08, CAL-FR-13, CAL-FR-14, CAL-FR-16, CAL-FR-17, CAL-AC-08, CAL-AC-09, CAL-AC-29; 070-results-reuse RES-FR-11, RES-AC-15; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-23; 071-storage-custody STO-FR-12; D-W98, D-W103, D-W113, D-W119
entries.action: Read the one-time offer for a generated calibration master found in Processing/, adopt it into the Calibration library, clearing PlateVault's own unregistered copy from its destination, and inspect the adopted master and its digest-bound state.
entries.expect: The Output step offers a generated master once; the Calibration library lists the adopted version with its provenance and date. Adoption refuses PlateVault's own unregistered copy at the master's destination, names it and offers a reviewed Move to Trash, then retries. A changed adopted copy reads drifted until its reviewed bytes are restored. A session that pins the changed master keeps the pin and reads the file as changed, with Reassign….
entries.negative: A detected candidate is never assigned before adoption. Adoption never overwrites a destination, and a drifted master is not assigned, accepted or re-adopted. Nothing switches to another master by itself.

entries.spec: 070-results-reuse RES-FR-06, RES-FR-07, RES-AC-06, RES-AC-07; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-14, PRJ-FR-25; D-W93, D-W97, D-W98, D-W100
entries.action: Close an open Project with an empty Output/ after resolving any pending changes, and try to close it while Apply is running.
entries.expect: Closing needs neither a Result nor evidence that an external job stopped. Output/ is kept, and Wrap up is refused while Apply is running on that Project.
entries.negative: Close does not remove Output/ or claim external processing success. A Closed or Archived Project cannot be edited or reopened.

entries.spec: 071-storage-custody STO-FR-01, STO-FR-03, STO-AC-01, STO-AC-20; 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-16; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-14; D-W97, D-W99, D-W100
entries.action: Open Clean up in the Project's Wrap up and inspect the offered View entries.
entries.expect: Clean up lists only the View entries PlateVault placed and what View (previous)/ still holds, grouped with counts, sizes, proposed actions and Inspect files. The View-removal offer starts selected for Copies and unselected for Symlinks.
entries.negative: Nothing in Output/ or Processing/ is listed. No original capture or library frame is a candidate, and the selection never covers the whole Project directory.

entries.spec: 071-storage-custody STO-FR-02, STO-FR-04, STO-AC-01; D19, D-W97, D-W100
entries.action: Inspect Clean up files and deselect one View entry.
entries.expect: Each entry shows its path, role, other Project references, retained-original evidence and estimated bytes; group counts update when an entry is deselected.
entries.negative: Link sizes are not presented as guaranteed reclaimed bytes, and inspection alone moves no file.

entries.spec: 071-storage-custody STO-FR-04, STO-FR-05, STO-AC-08; D19, D-W81, D-W97, D-W100
entries.action: Review selected Copies and Symlinks View entries before confirming Clean up.
entries.expect: The review lists exactly selected entries with Send to OS Trash and Trash support per location. Copies require verified retained originals; each symlink shows its identity and target path and is removed only after a no-follow check.
entries.negative: An entry with stale identity, drift, missing proof, unavailable source or ambiguous ownership is not approved. No symlink target or target directory is followed.

entries.spec: 071-storage-custody STO-FR-04, STO-FR-05, STO-AC-03, STO-AC-08, STO-AC-09, STO-AC-15; D19, D-W81, D-W97, D-W100
entries.action: Confirm reviewed Clean up after a retained original changes, on a location without safe Trash, and for selected symlink entries.
entries.expect: Per-item outcomes and an exact partial summary name every blocked entry. Approved copies go to OS Trash and verified PlateVault symlinks are removed with no-follow checks.
entries.negative: Link targets are not followed, changed or protected files stay in place, and no permanent-delete fallback exists.

entries.spec: 071-storage-custody STO-FR-06, STO-FR-07, STO-FR-08, STO-FR-11, STO-FR-13, STO-AC-05, STO-AC-07, STO-AC-10, STO-AC-14, STO-AC-17, STO-AC-27, STO-AC-29; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-14, PRJ-FR-25; 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-09; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-17; D06, D19, D-W97, D-W100, D-W111, D-W120
entries.action: From the Project's Wrap up Archive step, plan a verified archive transfer, meet an impostor destination, approve, interrupt and retry, change a source before retirement, repair a blocked reference, resolve the drift, and unplug the archive later. From Sessions, try to select a session an open Project holds and archive a session in no Project.
